text:
Maya: Heads up — CloudHaven wants to run a joint POC next Tue/Wed. They're evaluating inference latency for a multi-tenant support assistant and asked for a quick tech handoff. Key asks: SSO (SAML), VPC peering or allowlist, expected QPS (burst ~200 qps, steady ~40 qps), pilot sizing for ~50k tokens/day, and a pricing/commitment ask for a 3–6 month pilot. Can eng, sec, and solutions jump in?

Linda: I'll handle the commercial thread but need a ballpark reserved capacity vs hosted delta so I can respond to procurement. Also they asked about an SLA for pilot reporting.

Raj: I can run the POC from solutions side. Quick questions: which model are they planning to use (open vs licensed)? what's the expected prompt length / context window? are we doing embeddings + generation or just generation? Also need a partner contact — who at CloudHaven is coordinating?

Maya: Partner contact is AJ at CloudHaven (aj@cloudhaven.io). They're leaning open-models (Llama-style 70B family) quantized. Prompt lengths avg 400 tokens, occasional 1500 token traces. They want generation + some reranking.

Elaine: From runtime perspective — two viable approaches: Hosted (fastest to start) or Dedicated reserved pool for predictable latency. For their concurrency/burst profile I recommend Dedicated with autoscale burst enabled. Rough plan: 2x A100/A10 equivalent nodes for pilot (can scale to 4 if burst tests fail). If they opt Hosted, we route to a quantized 8-bit build and use prefix KV caching for frequent system prompts.

Elaine: Network allowlist snippet they can paste to their infra team:
```
Allow outbound egress to: 34.201.12.45/32, 54.212.33.100/32
TLS 443 to *.redwood-inference.com
If using VPC peering, request: peer CIDR 10.40.0.0/16
```

Tom: Security quick notes / blockers:
- Need completed security questionnaire before production access.
- For SAML: we need metadata XML and SP config; also ACS URL will be the customer's SSO redirect for Private or Dedicated control plane.
- Data residency: CloudHaven asked for EU processing; if required, we should provision Dedicated in eu-west-1 or Private.
- Pen-test: request their pen-test certificate or SOC report.
If they cannot provide those, recommend Private on-prem or air-gapped option.

Linda: Can you give a rough cost delta so I can propose numbers to procurement? they asked for monthly estimates for pilot (3mo) vs committed (6mo) pricing.

Raj: Ballpark numbers (very rough):
- Hosted pilot: assume $0.01 / 1k tokens generation + infra overhead — for 50k tokens/day that's ~ $15/day -> ~$450/mo, but latency will depend on queued concurrency.
- Dedicated reserved (2x A10-equivalent with autoscale): baseline ~$16k/mo reserved, inclusive of support & monitoring; we can offer a pilot discount for 3mo (~15% off) or a commit discount for 6mo (~25% off).
Notes: reserved price bundles throughput and lower per-token marginal. I'll sync with finance for exact SKU pricing.

Elaine: For the POC runbook I'll prepare a minimal test plan (load shape, telemetry hooks, token accounting, error modes) and a canary fallback to hosted if Dedicated saturates. I'll post the runbook doc link in the thread by EOD.

Tom: I'll start the security questionnaire today. Can someone upload the CloudHaven legal/security contact? I need their privacy policy, data retention expectations, and any special compliance asks (PCI/PHI).

Maya: I'll share AJ's contact in DM to Tom and Raj. Timeline: partner wants a demo environment provisioned by next Monday and a joint demo Wed. Is that feasible?

Raj: Feasible if we get SAML metadata + sample prompts and a small test dataset by end of day tomorrow. Also need a telemetry API endpoint to post perf metrics — infra-bot, can you create a short-lived test workspace and credentials?

infra-bot: Workspace r-poc-cloudhaven created: id=rwh-poc-2798, creds expire in 7 days. Endpoint: https://api.redwood-inference.com/workspaces/rwh-poc-2798/telemetry.

Elaine: Runbook checklist:
- Provision workspace + network allowlist (done)
- SAML config + test user (waiting on metadata)
- Baseline load test (100 users, ramp to 200 qps)
- Observe 95th pct latency and OOMs, KV cache hit rate
- Fallback route to hosted model (config snippet below)
```
route_policy: primary: dedicated-2node
fallback: hosted-quant8
max_latency_ms: 400
```

Tom: Also added to checklist: request CloudHaven's pen-test/SOC docs and a simple dataflow diagram. I can draft the minimal security attestation for the pilot to expedite procurement.

Maya: Great — action items: Elaine runbook + run test provisioning (Elaine), Raj coordinate prompts + pricing breakout (Raj), Tom start questionnaire (Tom), Linda prep SOW + pilot pricing (Linda). I'll own partner comms and demo scheduling.

Raj: I'll also include a small eval harness and example prompt set so we can monitor quality drift during the pilot.

Maya: Perfect. Thanks all — ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
